comparator.shared_aa_pattern: owner decision 160: one shared, already-sealed in-chain A/A may serve more than one composed family in the same chain; cell G5 reused this exact A/A the same way. COMP-1b goes one step further: it reuses the A/A as a pure CROSS-FLIGHT comparator with no re-flight of any kind in this family's own chain -- the A/A's bytes were already flown and sealed by cell COMP-1's own campaign.

decision_rule_fixed_here: Read against the SAME sealed in-chain A/A cell COMP-1 used, reused cross-flight and never re-flown (owner decision 160's shared-A/A pattern). PRIMARY: intent accuracy (scenario_action exact), paired per row, 10,000 bootstrap draws. GUARD: official pooled SLU-F1 non-inferior at the plan's own null (h_SLU 1.2485). ADMITTED: the intent CI95 lower bound above zero, the point at or above the declared 4.26 pp and the 2.5 pp cross-flight bar, AND the guard holds. NEUTRAL: both guards non-inferior at the own null (h_intent 0.9943 / h_SLU 1.2485) without an admitted gain. HARMFUL: a measured loss on either guard (decision 25). Every verdict carries the per-channel table the attribution note (a) / (b) / (c) split uses, the per-stratum tables in both weightings, and the same-shortlist intent-choice check.
development_numbers_only: Every number this cell will produce is a TRAIN Fold A construction-fold development number (owner decisions 28 and 86) and is never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. Budgets are run-cumulative across attempts.
